title: What Boston meteorologists are saying about this weekend’s humidity levels, the potential for pop-up storms
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: Humidity and heat remain high in Boston with temperatures near 90°F, feeling like 100°F this weekend.
The National Weather Service forecasts pop-up showers and storms Friday and Saturday evenings in southern New England.
Kelly Ann Cicalese notes humidity will remain high but decrease slightly by Sunday into Monday.

title: Here’s some background behind the vintage baseball glove a Red Sox fan gave to Aroldis Chapman
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Aroldis Chapman received a vintage 1930s Bob Feller model glove from Red Sox fan Andy Zides during a game.
Despite the gift, Chapman allowed a two-run homer, his first earned runs in over a month, in the win.
The Red Sox defeated the White Sox 12-11 in 13 innings, marking their eighth straight victory.

title: K-pop superstars BTS prepped for their Gillette shows at Planet Fitness in Downtown Crossing, apparently
author: Peter Chianca
bullets: BTS members Jung Hoseok, Kim Taehyung, and Jung Kook worked out at Planet Fitness in Downtown Crossing.
Jung Kook shared their workout visit at Planet Fitness on Instagram, documenting the experience for fans.
BTS performed sold-out shows at Gillette Stadium, earning more than Taylor Swift this year according to Forbes Korea.

title: Meet Marty: Cape Cod’s newest great white shark is sticking around
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: A new great white shark named Marty was identified by the Atlantic White Shark Conservancy off Cape Cod.
Marty, tagged on July 16, has been detected 15 times off North Truro, most recently on August 2.
Sales of White Shark Marty plush toys by Stop & Shop will contribute 20% to shark research and conservation.

title: 5 restaurants we can’t wait to try in August
author: Jillian Dara
bullets: About Thyme, a Lebanese bakery, offers saj-baked wraps and Middle Eastern flavors, opening in Harvard Square in early August.
Nana's Green Tea, a Tokyo-inspired matcha cafe, opens on Newbury Street, offering drinks and desserts made with matcha.
Tom Yum Yang in Allston features Thai BBQ and street food, with new culinary experiences from a mother-daughter duo.

title: Boston University joins growing list of colleges expanding financial aid
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Boston University will cap annual attendance costs at $20,000 for families earning under $200,000.
Families earning $75,000 or less will pay nothing at Boston University due to expanded financial aid.
Boston University joins other institutions like MIT and Harvard in significantly expanding need-based aid.

title: Mass. medical delivery worker charged after allegedly assaulting woman in wheelchair
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Qaisar Ali, 39, from Brockton, was arrested for allegedly assaulting a disabled woman in East Bridgewater.
Ali faces multiple charges, including assault and battery and indecent exposure, after an August 2 incident at the victim's home.
East Bridgewater Police arrested Ali on August 5, after identifying his vehicle; he was arraigned in Brockton District Court.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial closes out second week after friends and former father-in-law testify
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Lindsay Clancy's murder trial concludes its second week, featuring testimony from friends and former father-in-law describing her as a loving mother.
Defense attorney in Lindsay Clancy's trial raises issue of prosecutors' alleged 'hot mic' comment during emotional court session.
Dr. Alia Goodheart testified on Clancy's treatment, highlighting her postpartum struggles as Clancy maintains an insanity defense.

title: 5 takeaways as Red Sox overcome 5 deficits to outlast White Sox in 13 innings for 8th straight victory
author: Trevor Hass
bullets: The Boston Red Sox defeated the Chicago White Sox 12-11 in 13 innings, securing their eighth consecutive win.
Caleb Durbin delivered the walk-off RBI single, finishing with a 3-for-6 performance despite finger discomfort.
The game featured 17 pitchers and 447 combined pitches, marking another comeback as Red Sox overcame five deficits.

title: Patriots Stock Watch 1.0: Who is rising, falling on depth chart after 11 days of practice?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez impress during Patriots training camp, enhancing their stock on the roster.
Chad Muma and Terrell Jennings emerge as frontrunners for key positions, taking advantage of roster competition.
Kyle Williams and Caleb Lomu face setbacks, seeing reduced reps as they struggle in practice drills.
